let ContextSummary = () {
let _sigma_values = union (Events
| where Marker in~ ("A", "B", "C", "D")
| extend _sigma_timestamp = todatetime(["Timestamp"]), _sigma_group_0 = ["Host"], _sigma_value = pack_array(gettype(["Amount"]), ["Amount"])
| extend _sigma_rule = "SourceEvents")
| where isnotnull(_sigma_timestamp) and isnotempty(_sigma_group_0)
;
_sigma_values
| project _sigma_group_0, _sigma_window_end = _sigma_timestamp, _sigma_bin = bin(_sigma_timestamp, 5m)
| distinct *
| join kind=inner (
    _sigma_values
    | extend _sigma_bin = pack_array(bin(_sigma_timestamp, 5m), bin(_sigma_timestamp, 5m) + 5m)
    | mv-expand _sigma_bin to typeof(datetime)
) on _sigma_group_0, _sigma_bin
| where _sigma_timestamp between ((_sigma_window_end - 5m) .. _sigma_window_end)
| summarize ValueAvg = avgif(toreal(_sigma_value[1]), tostring(_sigma_value[0]) in ("int", "long", "real", "double", "decimal") and isfinite(toreal(_sigma_value[1]))), _sigma_numeric_count = countif(tostring(_sigma_value[0]) in ("int", "long", "real", "double", "decimal") and isfinite(toreal(_sigma_value[1]))) by _sigma_window_end, _sigma_group_0
| where _sigma_numeric_count > 0 and ValueAvg >= 2
| project WindowStart = _sigma_window_end - 5m, WindowEnd = _sigma_window_end, ["Host"] = _sigma_group_0, ValueAvg
};
let CorrelationMatches = materialize(ContextSummary()
| serialize CorrelationMatchId = row_number());
let WindowSourceMatches = materialize(
CorrelationMatches | project CorrelationMatchId, CompletionTime = WindowEnd, ContextGroupHost = ["Host"], ContextPartition = 1
| join kind=inner (
union (Events
| where Marker in~ ("A", "B", "C", "D")
| extend ContextEventTime = todatetime(["Timestamp"]), ContextGroupHost = ["Host"], ContextUser = ["User"]
| extend ContextSourceRule = "SourceEvents")
| project ContextEventTime, ContextSourceRule, ContextGroupHost, ContextUser, ContextPartition = 1
) on ContextGroupHost
| where ContextEventTime between ((CompletionTime - 5m) .. CompletionTime));
let CompleteContextRelationships = materialize(WindowSourceMatches
| project CorrelationMatchId, ContextUser
| distinct *);
let ValuesForUser = CompleteContextRelationships
| where isnotnull(ContextUser)
| summarize by CorrelationMatchId, ContextUser
| summarize DisplayedUser = make_list(ContextUser, 1000), DistinctUserCount = count() by CorrelationMatchId;
CorrelationMatches
| join kind=leftouter (ValuesForUser) on CorrelationMatchId
| extend ["User"] = coalesce(DisplayedUser, dynamic([]))
| extend ContextComplete = coalesce(DistinctUserCount, 0) <= 1000
| project ["WindowStart"], ["WindowEnd"], ["Host"], ["User"], ["ValueAvg"], ["ContextComplete"]
